events.verdict: Clarke (MEM) establishes a screening position in Green's (HOU) path when he brings two hands to Green's body and releases as he rolls towards the basket after setting the pick.
Green (HOU) moves alongside Morant's (MEM) path with a resting hand on Morant's side during the drive as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Sengun (HOU) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Clarke (MEM) brushes Green's (HOU) arm while he attempts to get to the loose ball as the contact that occurs during the rebound is marginal and does not affect Green's control of the ball.
Clarke (MEM) cleanly deflects the ball during Green's (HOU) pass attempt at the end of the drive.
Bane (MEM) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes one step before releasing the pass.
Sengun (HOU) brings his hand to Clarke's (MEM) back and slightly extends his arm as he releases in an attempt to pursue the loose ball. The contact that occurs during the rebound is marginal.
VanVleet (HOU) releases from Kennard (MEM) as both players come together at the end of the drive. The contact from VanVleet is marginal and does not affect Kennard's ability to defend.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) briefly engages and disengages with Brooks (HOU) as he attempts to establish position in the post.
Brooks (HOU) brushes Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm as he attempts to bring two hands to the ball end of the drive as the contact that occurs does not affect Jackson Jr.'s ability to gather.
Brooks (HOU) legally contests Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) post shot attempt.
VanVleet (HOU) gathers, jumps into the air, and releases the pass prior to returning to the floor.
Kennard (MEM) and Sengun (HOU) mutually engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
The ball deflects off Kennard's (MEM) leg prior to it going out of bounds.
Morant (MEM) legally contests Brooks's (HOU) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Holiday (HOU) does not dislodge Jackson Jr. (MEM) from his screening position during the throw-in.
Bane (MEM) crosses the plane of the free throw line before the ball makes contact with the rim.
VanVleet (HOU) commits a take foul on Bane (MEM).
Clarke (MEM) commits a take foul on Holiday (HOU).
